title: flowlint Intermediate Representation
description: Agent-agnostic description of a single user flow extracted from an application codebase. Agents produce this file; the deterministic renderer turns it into .drawio / .mmd / .svg.

id.description: Stable slug for this flow. Used as the output filename.

commit.description: Git SHA the flow was extracted from.

lanes.description: Optional swimlanes. When present every node SHOULD declare a lane. Convention: user -> ui -> api -> data.

metrics.description: Optional externally measured numbers (analytics, session replay). Never invented by the agent.

id.description: STABLE identifier. Derive it from route + component name, never from position or ordering. Renaming an id creates a churny git diff.

type.description: start/end = terminals. screen = a full page or route. modal = overlay/sheet. action = user interaction (tap, submit). decision = branch point. api = network call. data = persistence/cache. state = app or UI state. external = leaves the app (deep link, browser, OS). note = annotation only, no flow semantics.

lane.description: Lane id. Required when lanes are declared.

kind.description: happy = primary success path. error = failure handling. edge = rare/edge case. neutral = infrastructure.

route.description: URL path or named route, e.g. /checkout/payment

source.description: Traceability anchor: relative/path/to/File.tsx:120. REQUIRED for every node the agent derived from code.

taps.description: User interactions required to leave this node.

friction.description: Machine-checkable UX smells found in the code.

evidence.description: Extra source anchors backing the friction claims.

kind.description: back = returning/cancel transition; excluded from depth metrics and from layering.

condition.description: Guard expression as it appears in code, e.g. 'session == null'.
